task_observations: The fresh timestamped unpaired probe kept malformed JSON, OPTIONS, PATCH, DELETE, traversal, encoded NUL, emoji, long paths, and companion health behind HTTP 401 pairing_required; UI health stayed 200 before and after.
The separate paired 2,097,170-byte JSON request directly proved the body-size boundary with HTTP 413 and body_too_large.
The public same-origin bootstrap route paired each isolated curl session with HTTP 200 without reading or exposing a one-time token.
The paired burst produced deterministic throttling evidence: 119 HTTP 200 and 41 HTTP 429 responses, with rate_limited in all 41 throttled bodies.
After more than the required 61-second rate-limit recovery window, paired health returned HTTP 200.
The paired 2,097,170-byte JSON POST returned HTTP 413 with body_too_large, and paired health immediately remained HTTP 200.
